buys.item: Ceylon tea (sealed; Lion Logo if possible)
buys.why: Origin-packed grades/estates rarely stocked the same way in Bengaluru
buys.where: Estate shops (NE/Kandy), Ceylon Tea Museum area, Dilmah/Mlesna town stores

buys.why: Soft flaky C. verum vs thick cassia often sold as cinnamon in India
buys.where: Town spice shops / Kandy–Matale; compare supermarket vs garden stall
buys.notes: Thin multi-layer quills; thick hard bark = cassia

buys.why: Fresh local spice-route specialty; good kitchen gifts
buys.where: Markets + sealed supermarket packs (baseline before garden upsell)

buys.why: Destination craft with different supply than typical BLR tourist stock
buys.where: Laksala (price baseline) · Selyn-style handloom · Galle Fort named shops
buys.notes: Pattern irregularities = hand-drawn; machine print is the fake

buys.why: Local craft not commonly priced the same at home
buys.notes: Modern craft only; antiques 50+ yrs need export licence

skips.why: Highest-loss tourist scam (driver/stranger gem shops). Buy only if YOU chose an NGJA-licensed dealer + physical lab cert + export clearance — never for resale/investment.

skips.item: Airport tea walls / hotel gift markup
skips.why: Same brands cheaper in town/estate shops
Fake quality; harder at India arrival

shopping.notes: Personal-use sealed packs. SL departure: airport.lk lists up to 10 kg Sri Lanka tea duty-free (verify on day). India return: Baggage Rules 2026 general free allowance ₹75,000 for residents (Notification No. 14/2026) — verify before travel. Avoid fresh/raw plant products. Gems need NGJA paperwork if bought. Declare if unsure (Red Channel). Stay links: Agoda → MMT → Booking last resort.
